sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%carboplatin%' ORDER BY first_posting

rows.reasons: Delay in shipping of the drug|Demand increase|Demand increase for the drug|Discontinuation of the manufacture of the drug|Other|Requirements related to complying with good manufacturing practices
